# Criticality_Feature_Encoding

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of converting power-law criticality metrics into compact feature vectors for downstream classification or transmission in network-centric systems. Enables efficient data reduction and in-network aggregation, aligning with TCC's goal of moving computation into the network fabric.
